title: Set up the integral
text: The cardioid is traced once as θ goes from $$0$$ to $$2\pi$$ so the area is $$A=\frac{1}{2}\int_{0}**{2\pi}(1+\sin\theta)**2\,d\theta$$

title: Evaluate
text: Expand to $$1+2sin\left(\theta\right)+sin^2\left(\theta\right)$$. Over a full period the parts integrate to $$2\pi$$, $$0$$ and $$\pi$$ so the integral is $$3\pi$$ and $$A=\frac{3\pi}{2}$$.
